quote: Score: 3/10 — Technical Ambition Doesn't Equal PerfectionGTA VI is visually impressive, but stunning graphics and an ambitious open world don't automatically make a masterpiece. This game has technical issues, clunky mechanics, and uneven pacing raise legitimate concerns. What bothers me most is seeing critics acknowledge these flaws while still awarding perfect scores. A 100/100 doesn't require absolute perfection, but it should come with a convincing justification.Rockstar's reputation shouldn't exempt GTA VI from the same standards applied to other games. Great graphics don't excuse flawed gameplay.
